answer: Rate-limited registration stops sybil farming at the door: each new agent identity joins through a slow, verified onboarding queue with a small refundable deposit, and only a handful can register per day. An attacker spinning up thousands of sock puppets hits a glacier-slow wall of rising wait times and deposits, while relic device fingerprints from past bans block repeat attempts — like a crystal that only grows one layer at a time, the cost of one more fake identity stays higher than any reward it could earn.
